title: Qu3st
tagline: Qu3st is an app that takes a song or a sound file and uploads it along with the lyrics as an NFT
description: This project allows users to create NFTs based on a song. The user uploads the song, and the AI reads the song and transcribes it to words. Both the lyrics and the song are uploaded on NFT.storage.  Then users can view other minted songs and lyrics and be able to trade and sell NFTs.
how_its_made: The tech stack is MERN. I use NFT.Storage (Web3.Storage) to store the files before sending it to be minted with a NFT.  AI functionality to transcribe a sound file’s lyrics have not been implemented. Once stored, the sound file along with the lyrics are to be minted to a NFT via NFTport on the Polygon network. Zora is then used to add more functionality with the NFTs.
